results.question: How much of the domestic loan book falls under SMA-2 (60 to 90 days overdue) compared to the total loan assets?

results.pred_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.PERIOD_DELINQUENCY = 'ii.a.3 Overdue for 60 to 90 days (SMA -2)' THEN c.TOTAL_LOAN_ASSETS ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(c.TOTAL_LOAN_ASSETS), 0) AS proportion FROM CIMS_RAQ_Q_SEC1_PART_A_DOM c WHERE c.CODE = 757071 AND TO_CHAR(c.RDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_CHAR((SELECT MAX(RDATE) FROM CIMS_RAQ_Q_SEC1_PART_A_DOM), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
